name: data-platform-schema-describe-fieldsets-runtime
salesforceExclusionReason: This fixture exercises deterministic local field-set metadata and describe runtime behavior only; it makes no hosted Salesforce parity claim.

source.content: Schema.DescribeSObjectResult describe = Account.SObjectType.getDescribe(); System.assert(describe.fieldSets != null); Map<String, Schema.FieldSet> mapped = describe.fieldSets.getMap(); System.assert(mapped.containsKey('Summary')); Schema.FieldSet summary = describe.fieldSets.get('Summary'); System.assert(summary != null); System.assertEquals('Summary', summary.getName()); System.assertEquals(summary.getName(), summary.name); System.assertEquals('Summary Fields', summary.getLabel()); System.assertEquals(summary.getLabel(), summary.label); System.assertEquals('Fields shown on summary pages.', summary.getDescription()); System.assertEquals(summary.getDescription(), summary.description); System.assertEquals(Account.SObjectType, summary.getSObjectType()); System.assertEquals(summary.getSObjectType(), summary.sObjectType); List<Schema.FieldSetMember> members = summary.getFields(); System.assertEquals(members.size(), summary.fields.size()); System.assertEquals(2, members.size()); Schema.FieldSetMember nameMember = members.get(0); System.assert(nameMember.equals(nameMember)); System.assert(nameMember.hashCode() != 0); System.assert(nameMember.toString().contains('Name')); System.assertEquals('Name', nameMember.getFieldPath()); System.assertEquals(nameMember.getFieldPath(), nameMember.fieldPath); System.assertEquals('Account Name', nameMember.getLabel()); System.assertEquals(nameMember.getLabel(), nameMember.label); System.assert(nameMember.getRequired()); System.assertEquals(nameMember.getRequired(), nameMember.required); System.assert(nameMember.getDBRequired()); System.assertEquals(nameMember.getDBRequired(), nameMember.dbRequired); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.STRING, nameMember.getType()); System.assertEquals(nameMember.getType(), nameMember.type); System.assertEquals('Name', nameMember.getSObjectField().getDescribe().getLocalName()); System.assertEquals(nameMember.getSObjectField(), nameMember.sObjectField); Schema.FieldSetMember ratingMember = members.get(1); System.assertEquals('Rating', ratingMember.getFieldPath()); System.assertEquals(ratingMember.getFieldPath(), ratingMember.fieldPath); System.assert(ratingMember.getLabel().endsWith('Rating')); System.assertEquals(ratingMember.getLabel(), ratingMember.label); System.assert(!ratingMember.getRequired()); System.assertEquals(ratingMember.getRequired(), ratingMember.required); System.assert(!ratingMember.getDBRequired()); System.assertEquals(ratingMember.getDBRequired(), ratingMember.dbRequired); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.PICKLIST, ratingMember.getType()); System.assertEquals(ratingMember.getType(), ratingMember.type); System.assert(ratingMember.getSObjectField().getDescribe().getLocalName().endsWith('Rating')); System.assertEquals(ratingMember.getSObjectField(), ratingMember.sObjectField);
